seo.title: {name} | Gentle family and cosmetic dentistry
seo.description: Calm, modern dental care for the whole family: check-ups, whitening, aligners, implants and same-week emergency visits.

hero.title: Dentistry that feels like a deep breath.
hero.text: Unhurried appointments, clear prices and a team that explains every step. Check-ups, whitening, aligners and implants under one calm roof.

items.label: Patients who call us their dentist

treatments.title: Everything your smile needs, explained plainly.
treatments.text: Tap a treatment to see what happens, how long it takes and what it costs.

items.name: Check-up and clean
items.summary: A thorough exam, gentle scale and polish, and a plan you understand.
items.detail: We check teeth, gums and bite, take low-dose digital X-rays when needed, and finish with a hygienist clean. You leave with a written plan and no surprises.

items.name: Teeth whitening
items.summary: Up to eight shades brighter with custom trays or in-chair whitening.
items.detail: After a quick check we take impressions for custom trays, or whiten in the chair in one visit. Sensitivity-safe gels and a top-up kit included.

items.name: Clear aligners
items.summary: Straighter teeth with near-invisible aligners and a 3D preview first.
items.detail: A 3D scan shows your finished smile before you commit. Most people wear aligners for six to twelve months, with a check-in every eight weeks.

items.name: Dental implants
items.summary: Natural-looking replacements for missing teeth, planned with 3D imaging.
items.detail: We plan the implant on a 3D scan, place it under local anaesthetic and fit the crown once it has healed. Payment plans available.

items.name: Children's dentistry
items.summary: Friendly first visits that make kids look forward to the next one.
items.detail: Short, playful appointments, fissure sealants and fluoride varnish. Under-12s are seen free with a parent on a family plan.

items.name: Emergency care
items.summary: Toothache, a chipped tooth or a lost filling, seen the same day.
items.detail: Call before 11am and we will see you that day. We relieve pain first, then talk through options for a lasting fix.

results.title: Drag to see the difference.
results.text: A whitening and bonding treatment, finished in two visits. Results vary from person to person.

steps.title: Say hello
steps.text: Book online or call. We send a short form so we know your history before you arrive.

steps.title: Look and listen
steps.text: A full check with digital X-rays and photos you see on screen, and time to ask anything.

steps.title: Your plan, priced
steps.text: A written plan with options and prices. Nothing starts until you say yes.

steps.title: Care that lasts
steps.text: Treatment at your pace, then reminders for check-ups so small things stay small.

seo.title: {name} — Layers Hold Tales of Time
seo.description: Explore the deep history of Earth's crust through interactive geological strata maps and field guides.

hero.left: Every layer of sediment records a chapter of our planet, from ancient seabeds to drifting ash, layered across millions of years beneath us.
hero.right: Our interactive maps let you peel back the crust to trace how stones, fossils, and deep time combine to shape the ground beneath your feet.

course.title: Read the ground like a book
course.text: Eight short chapters take you from a pebble in your hand to four billion years of Earth history. Watch, then dig into each layer on the map.

chapters.title: How layers form
chapters.text: Rivers, seas and volcanoes lay down sediment grain by grain. See how a single flood becomes a band of rock.

chapters.title: Reading a rock face
chapters.text: Colour, grain size and fossils tell you where a layer came from and how old it is.

chapters.title: Deep time
chapters.text: Put millions of years into a scale you can feel, from the first cells to last week's mud.

chapters.title: Faults and folds
chapters.text: Why layers tilt, break and bend, and what that says about the forces underneath.

chapters.title: Fossils as clocks
chapters.text: Use index fossils to date a layer in the field without a lab.

guides.title: Pocket guides for the trail
guides.text: Download a guide, take it offline and match what you see on the cliff to what is in your hand.

items.title: Ammonites and shells
items.text: Spot, name and date the most common marine fossils in limestone.

items.title: Crystals and ores
items.text: Tell quartz from calcite with a scratch, a drop and a lens.

items.title: Canyons and cliffs
items.text: Read a whole valley wall from the viewpoint, layer by layer.

geology.title: Peel back the crust
geology.text: Point at a layer to see what it is made of and how long ago it was laid down.

layers.name: Topsoil and loess
layers.text: Wind-blown dust and roots: the youngest layer, still forming today.

layers.name: Glacial till
layers.text: Unsorted clay and boulders dropped by melting ice sheets.

layers.name: Chalk and limestone
layers.text: The shells of countless sea creatures, pressed into white rock with ammonites inside.

layers.name: Red sandstone
layers.text: Ancient desert dunes, still showing the slant of the wind that built them.

layers.name: Volcanic ash band
layers.text: A single eruption, a few centimetres thick, that dates everything around it.

layers.name: Granite basement
layers.text: Crystalline rock that cooled deep underground before any of the layers above existed.

plans.title: Choose how deep you go
plans.text: Start free. Upgrade when you want offline guides and live tours.
